provenance.notes: Saved check 35801, source auction_lot 16248 (lot 185-907522, lot number 185-04290), a second Batch #9 lot in the same auction, not lot 16250 judged earlier. Its page states Batch Number 9 and 59.2% ABV / 70cl. The saved search evidence already holds the answer: maltrunners.com and sohowine.co.uk give 59.2% for Batch 9, and shopwinedirect.com gives '118.2 proof (59.1% ABV)'. That is a 0.1 difference from one retailer's proof conversion. Batch 9 is one batch; no 59.1% Batch 9 exists, so the gap does not mark a different release. 69059 stores Kilkerran Heavily Peated, edition Batch #9, 59.2%, Brand Kilkerran, distiller Glengyle, and no field conflicts.

expected.summary: Match Kilkerran Heavily Peated Batch #9 (69059). The lot, the stored Bottle and several product pages give 59.2%; one US retailer's '118.2 proof (59.1% ABV)' is a rounding difference, not another release.
